talk.transcript: Today, we'll explore the concept of sustainability. Sustainability refers to meeting our own needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs. It encompasses environmental, social, and economic dimensions. For instance, sustainable practices include renewable energy usage, waste reduction, and conserving biodiversity. By adopting sustainable lifestyles, we can protect our planet and ensure a healthy environment for the years to come.

questions.explain: 可持續性是滿足當前需求的概念。

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a sustainable practice?
questions.explain: 污染水源不是可持續的做法。
可持續性包括環境、社會和經濟維度。

questions.q: Why is adopting sustainable lifestyles important?
questions.explain: 採用可持續生活方式對保護地球至關重要。
